modifiedSource: Frozen clean commit recorded in provenance; only skill-scope catalog intervention.
intervention: T1: append bounded name/scope metadata from enabled configured skills to the immutable Light startup system prompt. Keep skill availability, full bodies, tool schemas, validation and recovery unchanged. Native Cline does not receive the new catalog.
taskSelection: Selected and registered before any T1 model outcomes. These existing corpus tasks contributed to the prior skill-cost diagnosis; all are known diagnostics, not unseen confirmation.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, pinned installed dependencies, fresh identical fixture per paired task; no memory or solution retrieval. Provider nondeterminism, retries and cache are uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Existing USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard. Stop starting new trials at observed USD 0.30; retain planned but unexecuted trials and missing usage. Estimates are not invoice caps. Canary and global budgets are separate.

ordering: Unchanged driver: manifest order in repetition one; reversed task and arm order in repetition two. Arm rotation uses the full task index, so indices >=3 retain base arm order. Sequential, no replacement or outcome-driven stopping.
quality: Primary audited instruction compliance AND successful runtime completion. Preserve original score, functional scorer, post-edit agent validation, finish admission and runtime status separately. Audit all inputs/source without solution recovery. Apply the known webhook old-handler-after-clear replay, pagination valid ISO offset/equal-instant replay and reducer physical-property versus value-level convention uniformly. Report strict criteria and the previously identified alternative interpretations separately; never erase official results.
accounting: Observe input+output tokens as primary efficiency, with task-matched audited-completion AND usage-reconciled pairs, plus whole-panel success/failure resources. Cache tokens are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output; do not double count. Preserve timeouts and missing request/cache/provider usage. Report task-cluster paired uncertainty. Category bytes measure repeated context exposure, not billed tokens; native categories absent.
decision: Run the registered canary and then the fixed all-25 two-repetition campaign regardless of favorable canary outcomes unless quality, access or configured budgets block further execution. No superiority claim from selective task subsets. Catalog hypothesized to reduce irrelevant skills calls and input tokens; risks are omitted useful skills, stale startup metadata and added prefix cost. Keep this single change only if audited completion quality is preserved and the mechanism helps. All tasks are diagnostics; broader generalization requires a separate fresh confirmation campaign.
